To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of dual-axis tracking (DAT) system can be predicted using the output of a fixed tilt system (FT) and that this prediction can be made without any knowledge of the sun position or the irradiance.
the variability of a dual-axis tracking system can be predicted from the output data of fixed-tilts systems.
a simple method was developed to predict the performance of a DT system from FT system data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the prediction of DT system performance from FT system data.
the variability of the energy output of a solar system.
the variability of the energy output from a solar PV system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a simple and effective method for predicting the magnitude and variability of DT from FT data has been developed.

the variability of a DT system can be predicted from that of a FT system, but that the magnitude prediction of the output of a DT system from that of a similar sized FT system will not be accurate unless the sun's elevation is known.
, for the purpose of predicting the performance of DT from that of FT, the simple method presented in this paper can provide a good estimate of the output of DT systems from FT system output data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DT system is not always the best choice for a solar system.
the DT system is not a better solution than the FT system in all circumstances, and that the choice between the two should be based on the specific site conditions.
a simple and easily implemented prediction technique is available for predicting DT system output from FT output data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the variability of DT systems can be predicted using a simple model.
the variability of a DT system can be predicted from FT output data.
the variability of a dual-axis tracking system is highly correlated to the variability of a fixed-tilt PV system.
